{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA rows (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA rows: {len(qa_rows)}")

# Check if any QA rows have converted = 1
print(f"QA rows with converted = 1: {qa_rows['converted'].sum()}")

# Check if any QA rows have status = 'completed'
print(f"QA rows with status = 'completed': {qa_rows['status'].eq('completed').sum()}")"}
